Subject: MAP: Closure cadence, escrow & evidence gating for Northbridge pilot

Elena / team —

Thanks for the time yesterday. Attaching our first-pass MAP (MAP_Northbridge_v2.xlsx) and a short acceptance criteria doc. Key asks to align on so we can lock dates: 

- Procurement sequence: does Northbridge need an executed Order Form to commit budget before the DPA/MSA can be signed, or can legal sign a DPA first and add the Order Form later?
- Escrow schedule: you asked about escrow for model artifacts / weights — we typically require an escrow option for enterprise customers with an 18-month retention trigger; want to confirm Northbridge preference (signed escrow addendum at signature vs escrow held post-acceptance).
- Evidence windows: SOC 2 report and audit logs — we can provide SOC 2 type II report and a snapshot of audit log retention. Please confirm which artifacts Legal needs for their procurement packet.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0: DPA redline and MSA alignment (light redline preferred)
- Week 1: Procurement approves budget (Order Form drafted; can be sign-at-acceptance if required)
- Week 3: Pilot evaluation (acceptance criteria attached)
- Week 4: Order Form signature -> production enablement

If you want a different sequencing (Order Form first -> DPA after), we can accommodate but would need a short-term interim comms quid-pro-quo (e.g., budget hold/PO) so we can reserve capacity.

Please confirm timeline constraints and who on your side owns legal / procurement so we can add them to the MAP.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao

2) Regarding escrow: we usually ask for escrow to be in place at signature for model weights if the vendor is providing proprietary weights. Can you confirm whether Redwood is asking for escrow for weights or just for configuration artifacts? Also who will be the escrow agent?

3) Evidence: Legal needs a SOC 2 Type II report and a data-retention statement for logs (preferred 90 days). The audit team might ask for a short evidence manifest.

If it helps we can run a parallel track: procurement prepares the PO/Order Form while Legal finalizes DPA redlines. Would Redwood accept an Order Form that references a DPA signing window (e.g. DPA signed within 30 days of Order Form signature)?

Aditya / team —

Thanks for the context. Short answers / recommended sequencing from Legal: 

1) Sequence: Preferred (fastest, lowest risk) = MSA + DPA signed together, then Order Form signature to confirm spend. Alternate (if procurement insists) = Order Form signed with express clause: "Order Form is effective upon execution but subject to execution of DPA within 30 days; if DPA is not executed within 30 days, Order Form is voidable by Redwood." We can accept the alternate with the voidable clause.

2) Escrow: For custom-tuned weights we treat escrow as a special request. We can provide an escrow addendum; typical escrow agents we use are Iron Mountain or EscrowTech. The addendum should specify artifacts (weights & model binaries) and release triggers (company insolvency or material breach). Draft language in DPA addendum: scope, agent, release conditions, escrow retention period (18 months) and verification procedures.

3) Evidence & logs: We'll provide SOC 2 Type II (current FY) and an operational snapshot of audit logs. Note: our standard retention is 180 days; we can agree to 90 days for this deal but need to log that as a contractual exception in the DPA (exception tracked in our Evidence Matrix).

4) DocuSign & sequencing: Legal can produce the DPA redline summary (DPA_redline_summary.pdf). SalesOps should include a DocuSign bundle that contains MSA+DPA+Order Form or, if using the alternate sequence, an Order Form with the 30-day DPA clause and a link to follow-up DPA DocuSign.

I'll draft the escrow addendum and the DPA exception language. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
